Aria: Heads-up: new onboarding reports — users hit a weird SSE parse state after a client abort + reconnect. I reproduced locally.
Noah: which sampleapp + SDK versions?
Aria: sampleapp@main, js-sdk@0.9.2, go-sdk@0.6.5. Steps: open the streaming example, let it idle ~12s, UI triggers controller.abort(), page auto-reconnects.
Vik: paste the raw frames if you captured them.
Aria: captured minimal frames:
```
SSE id: 101
data: {"delta":"line1"}

SSE id: 102
data: {"delta":" line2"}

-- client abort/reconnect --
SSE id: 102
data: " line2"
SSE id: 103
data: {"delta":" line3"}
```
Aria: JS SDK concatenates the repeated id:102 and JSON merge results in "line1 line2 line2 line3"; go-sdk treats the second id:102 as a new message and overwrites the partial buffer -> "line1 line2 line3" (missing duplicate token).
Olga: looks like server resends last-event when Last-Event-Id not provided. Does sampleapp forward last-event-id on reconnect?
Noah: no, reconnect path only resends Authorization header. Bug in sampleapp onboarding flow.
Vik: SDK question: should clients dedupe by event id or by byte overlap? Need a spec so parity tests can pass.
Aria: my suggestion: sampleapp should set Last-Event-Id on reconnect. For SDKs, default to event-id dedupe (less fuzzy) and expose a stitch policy for byte-coalescing for apps that need it.
Olga: agreed. Short-term: change sampleapp to bump idle timer -> 30s, forward Last-Event-Id on reconnect, and document the gotcha.
Noah: I'll add a tiny e2e that simulates an abort then reconnection where server resends the last id. Test should assert identical final assembled text across JS/Go/Python.
Vik: also add a unit test in each SDK for overlapping fragments: two fragments with same id but split bytes vs repeated resend.
ci-bot: created ticket DEVX-1122: "streaming reconnect: fragment dedupe/stitch parity + sampleapp fixes"
Aria: I've uploaded the full capture here: https://paste.redwood.com/stream/3332109876-repro and included browser console logs.
Olga: PR is live for sampleapp: https://github.com/redwood/sampleapp/pull/169 — increases idle timeout, forwards Last-Event-Id header, and adds e2e harness for reconnect scenarios.
Noah: I'll add infra harness to replay SSE frames with controlled reorder/delay so CI will catch regressions.
Vik: for SDK API, propose: StreamOptions.stitchPolicy = 'event-id'|'byte-coalesce' (default 'event-id') and add changelog note.
Aria: thanks — this will reduce onboarding confusion. Leaving DEVX-1122 with repro steps and links. :+1:
